messages:
deploybot: Starting staged rollout: service=model-hosting image=v7.3.0 -> rolling 5% canary to eu-west (canary group A). Change summary: KV-cache eviction fix + selective kernel tuning. launch id=cli-1768459999 :rocket:
Sofia: Kicking this off. @Kelly-oncall FYI, monitoring dashboards up.
Sofia: rolling -> eu-west 5% canary now.
infra-mon: Alert (1768460005): p99 latency spike detected in eu-west canary pool, magnitude +120ms vs baseline. Sampled requests show KV cache miss rate up ~18%.
Max: Saw the alert. Correlating with canary traffic, looks like increased rehydration across certain shard ids.
Jen: Any OOMs or CPU jumps?
Rafael: Logs from the canary pods show a single instance with OOM events around the spike: "OOMKilled" then restart. stack: inference_worker -> kv_cache
Rafael: Pod: mh-canary-eu-7b-3c9f, node: eu-west-3b.
Amanda: Hmm, v7.3.0 includes a cache-index layout change; if rehydration churn rises it can push memory up transiently.
Kelly-oncall: Paging infra to check node-level memory usage, but we should consider pausing before broadening.
Sofia: Proposal: PAUSE rollout in eu-west and pin traffic back to v7.2.1 for eu-west only, investigate further. Keep other regions unchanged. Thoughts?
Max: Agree. Can't risk tail latency regressions. +1 to pin.
Jen: +1. If it's a mem regression we should avoid automated retries that amplify churn.
Amanda: Recommend rollback-without-rollback: pin previous variant and keep canary pods isolated for debug (no traffic). That gets production back to stable quickly.
deploybot: Awaiting ops vote: to pin eu-west -> v7.2.1 now? React with :thumbsup: to confirm, :thumbsdown: to continue. Timeout 5m.
Sofia: :thumbsup:
Max: :thumbsup:
Jen: :thumbsup:
Rafael: :thumbsup: (will collect logs from canary pod before it gets replaced)
Kelly-oncall: :thumbsup: (agree, will coordinate with infra to snapshot node)
infra-mon: Noted. Capturing metrics + flamegraphs to go/infra/1773-dumps.
deploybot: Vote passed. Pausing rollout and pinning traffic in eu-west to v7.2.1. Executing pin sequence now.
deploybot: Commands run:
```
# pin traffic for region
redwood rollout pin --service model-hosting --region eu-west --target-version v7.2.1 --reason "canary p99 tail spike / kv-cache OOMs"
redwood rollout pause --service model-hosting --region eu-west
```
deploybot: Pin complete. Canary group A in eu-west set to 0% traffic; traffic routed to v7.2.1.
Sofia: Opening a follow-up incident ticket: RW-2345 (canary-eu kvcache rehydration). Link: https://go/redwood/incident/RW-2345
Amanda: For next steps: 1) collect heap profiles from the failing pod, 2) reproduce locally with synthetic load, 3) revert cache-index layout tweak if repro is reliable.
Rafael: I grabbed the pod logs + core dump, uploaded to go/infra/1773-dumps, named mh-canary-eu-7b-3c9f-core.tar.gz
Max: I'll run a staged load test against a v7.3.0 replica with debug flags to exercise rehydrate path.
Jen: We should also check autoscaler backoff behavior — restarts might cause traffic to shift and amplify errors.
Sofia: Decision: hold eu-west at v7.2.1 for now. No global rollback. Resume window tentatively in 2h after data & repro. If more OOMs or >2% customer-facing errors we escalate to full rollback.
Kelly-oncall: Noted. I'll run the post-pin health check and confirm no lingering tail.
Sofia: Thanks all. Please add any findings to RW-2345 thread.
deploybot: Logged action: rollout paused (eu-west), pin applied, audit id=aud-1768460119."
